\tabnotes{The dependent variable is the raw one-year excess return
  $\rx^{(n)}_{i,t+12}$ for $n\in\{2,5,10\}$ years in each of the
  eleven markets. The Fama--Bliss regression projects the return on the
  forward--spot spread $f^{(n)}_{i,t}-y^{(1)}_{i,t}$ \citep{famabliss1987};
  the Cochrane--Piazzesi regression projects it on the local forward-rate
  factor $\CP_{i,t}$ \citep{cochrane2005}. $t$-statistics in parentheses are
  Newey--West adjusted ($12$ lags); adjusted $R^{2}$ reported. The table
  replicates \citet{dahlquist2013}, Table~4.}
